liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (2 reviews): Althea is a personal favorite; reviewer says Garcia puts extra effort into several songs; Clouds parted mid-Althea just after Garcia said the space was getting hot; the crowd audibly reacts [17][19]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Opening Cassidy included a lyric slip, though the reviewer found the music strong [23]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Very fast China Cat with a smooth transition into I Know You Rider, called outstanding [16]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Playing in the Band has excellent jamming, with the late Space into The Wheel also praised [16]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Throwing Stones into Not Fade Away, usually skipped by this reviewer, really rocks here [17]

## The recordings

- **gd83-08-21.sennheiser.bennet.10920.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1983-08-21.150944.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: source not stated; 19 songs; 145 min [4]
- **gd83-08-21.nak300cp4-reutelhuber.miller.23853.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [8]. Said about its sound: Soundboard transfer has dropouts and weak dynamics, sounds aged and tiring to listen to [21]
- **gd1983-08-21.155989.fob.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 138 min [9]
- **gd1983-08-21.148073.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 139 min [11]
- **gd1983-08-21.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95672.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 4.67/5 by 9 [13]. Said about its sound: Very close, up-front recording with excellent separation; reviewer says it needs very high volume [25]
- **gd1983-08-21.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95687.flac24**: source not stated; 9 songs; 137 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [15]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this recording is best played loud, though it works at low volume too [22]

## Around the show

- Mild day, not scorching; green trees, a skull and roses over the stage, Hoover Tower behind [19]
- Reviewer took an 83-hour Greyhound ride from Wilmington, NC, traveling with a mixed group heading to the Bay Area [20]
- Reviewer ranks this China Cat into Rider as the best of at least August 1983 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd83-08-21.sennheiser.bennet.10920.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Senn 441>Sony TC-D5>DAT>CD [1]. Also: Front-of-board Sennheiser 441 to Sony TC-D5 to DAT to CD, via Pete; seeded to etree by Jim Bennett [1]
- **gd1983-08-21.150944.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: A Sennheiser 441 source from Kirschner and Miller supplies Cassidy's first 3:04 and a patch in Drums into Space [4]
- **gd83-08-21.nak300cp4-reutelhuber.miller.23853.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info: (Immediate Left Of SBD) Nakamichi 300/CP4 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5)Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi Deck/Azimuth Aligned) -> Mytek… [8]
- **gd1983-08-21.155989.fob.senn441.neumann.u87.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441's (Left + Right) + (1) Neumann U87 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [9]. Also: A Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner supplies a 13-second patch in Throwing Stones [9]
- **gd1983-08-21.148073.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [11]. Also: A Beyer M201 source supplies Samson & Delilah's first 23 seconds, plus a patch in Drums into Space [11]
- **gd1983-08-21.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95672.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Michael Kirschner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B) [13]. Also: Reviewer says the master tapes carry Rango's handwriting, suggesting he made it, with equipment matching the other source [26]
- **gd1983-08-21.fob.sonyECM220t.kirschner.miller.95687.flac24**: taped by Michael Kirschner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/FujiMetal Tape/Dolby B) [15]
